title: Emergence of collectivity in the $0^+_2$ band of $^{92}$Zr
byline: Williams; E J; Garrett; P E; Avaa; A A; Garnsworthy; A B; Hackman; Mantle; L; Morales; S Murillo; Murias; J R; Svensson; C E; Umashankar; Zhu; Y
html:
Abstract:The $2^+_2 \rightarrow 0^+_2$ transition in $^{92}$Zr was observed for the first time in a high-statistics decay study of the 10-day isomer $^{92m}$Nb. Its $E2$ transition strength of 8.9(7) W.u. is enhanced by 40% relative to the ground state band, providing evidence for a collective structure built on the $0^+_2$ state which is analogous to the deformed shape-coexisting configuration in $^{94}$Zr.
